result.instructions: Tools for ClouDNS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which DNS zones do I manage in ClouDNS?"; "Show the TXT records on _dmarc.example.com."; "Add a TXT record for my domain verification code with a 1 hour TTL.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ClouDNS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cloudns_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cloudns_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cloudns_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cloudns_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cloudns_list_zones
tools.title: List DNS zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones in the account, or the zones whose name matches a keyword. Paged; reverse zones are included. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/list-zones.json.

search.description: Zone name or keyword to match.

group_id.description: Only zones in this group ID.

tools.name: cloudns_get_zone_info
tools.title: Get zone information
tools.description: Get one zone: its status, whether it is a master or slave zone, forward or reverse, a cloud domain or a GeoDNS zone. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/get-zone-info.json.

domain_name.description: Zone name, for example example.com, or a reverse zone name.

tools.name: cloudns_list_records
tools.title: List DNS records
tools.description: List the records of a zone, optionally for one host or one record type. host_like matches part of the host and then ignores host. Master zones only. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/records.json.

domain_name.description: Zone name, for example example.com, or a reverse zone name.

host.description: Only records for this host, for example www.

host_like.description: Partial host match; ignores host when set.

type.description: Record type, for example A, MX or TXT.

tools.name: cloudns_add_txt_record
tools.title: Add a TXT record
tools.description: Add a TXT record to a master zone. This changes live DNS. Calling it again with the same values adds a duplicate record. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/add-record.json.

domain_name.description: Zone name, for example example.com, or a reverse zone name.

record.description: The TXT value, for example v=spf1 -all.

tools.name: cloudns_get_failover_settings
tools.title: Get DNS failover settings
tools.description: Get the DNS Failover settings of one record that has DNS Failover & Monitoring active. The API reports Failed when failover is not active on that record. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/failover-settings.json.

domain_name.description: Zone name, for example example.com, or a reverse zone name.

tools.name: cloudns_list_monitoring_checks
tools.title: List monitoring checks
tools.description: List monitoring checks with their status (up, down or unknown) and state (active or paused). Check types: 17 Ping, 18 Web, 8 TCP, 9 UDP, 10 DNS, 12 Heartbeat, 13 TLS (SSL) certificate, 15 SMTP, 16 Streaming, 19 IMAP, 20 Keyword. ClouDNS API: POST /monitoring/get-records.json.

check_type.description: Check type ID from the list in this tool's description.

search.description: Text to find in the check name or IP address.

include_note.description: Include the notes on each check.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ClouDNS
prompts.description: What you can do with ClouDNS here, with example requests to try.
